'''Arviz Linden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who ran a [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] [[Hyperbaride synthesis plant|plant]] on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]] by [[Dynamic Synergetics, Inc.]] Linden used the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[M-3PO-C]] as his secretary. Linden kept the [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|plant's]] production at a minimum to protect the native [[Sekct]], and M-3PO-C admired him for that. M-3PO-C was dismayed after learning of Linden's death of a mysteriously ruptured [[trachea]].
